SparkR / SPARKR-203
Load and Save DataFrames
Issue Type: Sub-task
Assignee: Unassigned
Created: 17/Feb/15 6:24 PM
Priority: Major
Reporter: Shivaram Venkataraman

We should add support to load data frames in SQLContext given just a datasource name (as specified in https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/SPARK-5420)

Similarly we should add support to save out DataFrames. Relevant PySpark code

Load
https://github.com/apache/spark/blob/e50934f11e1e3ded21a631e5ab69db3c79467137/python/pyspark/sql/context.py#L573

Save
https://github.com/apache/spark/blob/e50934f11e1e3ded21a631e5ab69db3c79467137/python/pyspark/sql/dataframe.py#L192
